# One probe per line: VBA statements, then ``;;``, then the expression
# whose answer is recorded.  Each probe gets a freshly added worksheet,
# so the grid starts empty and nothing leaks from the probe before it.
#
# Measured in live Excel by ``python scripts/measure_vba_semantics.py
# excel`` and replayed against the in-memory model by
# tests/test_excel_model.py.

# --- addresses ---
Range("A1").Address
Range("a1").Address
Range("A1:B2").Address
Range("B2:A1").Address
Range("$A$1").Address
Range("A1").Address(False, False)
Range("A1:B2").Address(False, True)
Cells(3, 4).Address
Rows(3).Address
Columns(2).Address
Columns("C").Address
Range("A:B").Address
Range("2:4").Address
Range("A1").Offset(1, 2).Address
Range("A1:B2").Offset(1, 1).Address
Range("B2").Offset(-1, -1).Address
Range("A1").Resize(3, 2).Address
Range("A1:C3").Resize(1, 1).Address
Range("B2").EntireRow.Address
Range("B2").EntireColumn.Address
Range("A1", "C3").Address
Range("A1:B2").Cells(2, 2).Address
Range("B2:D4").Cells(1).Address
Range("B2:D4").Cells(4).Address
Range("A1:B3").Rows(2).Address
Range("A1:C1").Columns(3).Address
Application.Union(Range("A1"), Range("C3")).Address
Application.Union(Range("A1"), Range("C3")).Areas.Count
Application.Intersect(Range("A1:C3"), Range("B2:D4")).Address
Range("A1:B2").Row
Range("B3:D5").Column
Range("A1:B3").Count
Range("A1:B3").Rows.Count
Range("A1:B3").Columns.Count
Range("A:A").Count
Range("A1").Worksheet.Name = ActiveSheet.Name
Right(Range("A1").Address(External:=True), Len(ActiveSheet.Name) + 6) = ActiveSheet.Name & "!$A$1"
Left(Range("A1").Address(External:=True), 1)

# --- what lands in a cell ---
Range("A1").Value = 5 ;; Range("A1").Value
Range("A1").Value = 5 ;; TypeName(Range("A1").Value)
Range("A1").Value = 5.5 ;; TypeName(Range("A1").Value)
Range("A1").Value = "5" ;; TypeName(Range("A1").Value)
Range("A1").Value = "5" ;; Range("A1").Value
Range("A1").Value = "abc" ;; TypeName(Range("A1").Value)
Range("A1").Value = True ;; TypeName(Range("A1").Value)
Range("A1").Value = #1/2/2020# ;; TypeName(Range("A1").Value)
Range("A1").Value = #1/2/2020# ;; CDbl(Range("A1").Value)
Range("A1").Value = "1/2/2020" ;; TypeName(Range("A1").Value)
Range("A1").Value = Empty ;; TypeName(Range("A1").Value)
Range("A1").Value = "" ;; TypeName(Range("A1").Value)
Range("A1").Value = "" ;; IsEmpty(Range("A1").Value)
;; TypeName(Range("Z99").Value)
;; IsEmpty(Range("Z99").Value)
;; Range("Z99").Value = 0
Range("A1").Value = 5 ;; Range("A1").Formula
Range("A1").Value = 5 ;; TypeName(Range("A1").Formula)
Range("A1").Value = "abc" ;; Range("A1").Formula
Range("A1").Value = 5 ;; Range("A1").Text
Range("A1").Value = 1234.5: Range("A1").NumberFormat = "#,##0.00" ;; Range("A1").Text
Range("A1").Value = 0.5: Range("A1").NumberFormat = "0%" ;; Range("A1").Text
Range("A1").Value = 5 ;; Range("A1").NumberFormat
Range("A1:B2").Value = 3 ;; Range("B2").Value
Range("A1:A3").Value = 1 ;; Application.WorksheetFunction.Sum(Range("A1:A3"))
Range("A1").Value = 1: Range("A2").Value = 2 ;; TypeName(Range("A1:A2").Value)
Range("A1").Value = 1: Range("A2").Value = 2 ;; UBound(Range("A1:A2").Value, 1)
Range("A1").Value = 1: Range("A2").Value = 2 ;; UBound(Range("A1:A2").Value, 2)
Range("A1").Value = 1: Range("A2").Value = 2 ;; LBound(Range("A1:A2").Value, 1)
Range("A1:B2").Value = Array(7, 8) ;; Range("B1").Value
Range("A1:B2").Value = Array(7, 8) ;; Range("A2").Value
Range("A1").Value = 5: Range("A1").ClearContents ;; TypeName(Range("A1").Value)
Range("A1").Value = 5: Range("A1").Clear ;; TypeName(Range("A1").Value)

# --- the grid ---
Range("A1").Value = 1 ;; ActiveSheet.UsedRange.Address
Range("C3").Value = 1 ;; ActiveSheet.UsedRange.Address
Range("A1").Value = 1: Range("C3").Value = 2 ;; ActiveSheet.UsedRange.Address
;; ActiveSheet.UsedRange.Address
Range("A1").Value = 1: Range("A2").Value = 2 ;; Range("A1").End(xlDown).Address
Range("A1").Value = 1 ;; Range("A1").End(xlDown).Address
Range("A1").Value = 1: Range("A5").Value = 2 ;; Range("A1").End(xlDown).Address
Range("A1").Value = 1: Range("A5").Value = 2 ;; Range("A5").End(xlUp).Address
Range("A1").Value = 1: Range("C1").Value = 2 ;; Range("A1").End(xlToRight).Address
;; Range("A1").End(xlDown).Address
;; Range("D4").End(xlUp).Address
Range("A1:A3").Value = 1: Range("A2").Delete ;; Range("A2").Value
Range("A1:A3").Value = 1: Range("A1").Insert ;; TypeName(Range("A1").Value)
Range("A1").Value = 9: Range("A1").Copy Range("C3") ;; Range("C3").Value

# --- the book and its sheets ---
Dim s As Worksheet: Set s = ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets.Add ;; s.Index - ActiveSheet.Index
Dim s As Worksheet: Set s = ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets.Add(After:=ActiveSheet) ;; s.Index
Dim s As Worksheet: Set s = ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets.Add ;; TypeName(s)
;; TypeName(ActiveSheet)
;; TypeName(ActiveWorkbook)
;; TypeName(Application)
;; ActiveSheet.Index = ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets(ActiveSheet.Name).Index
;; Worksheets(ActiveSheet.Name).Name = ActiveSheet.Name
;; TypeName(Worksheets)
;; TypeName(Range("A1"))
;; TypeName(Range("A1").Font)
;; TypeName(Range("A1").Interior)
;; Range("A1").Font.Bold
Range("A1").Font.Bold = True ;; Range("A1").Font.Bold
Range("A1").Font.Size = 14 ;; Range("A1").Font.Size
;; Len(Range("A1").Font.Name) > 0
Range("A1").Interior.Color = RGB(255, 255, 0) ;; Range("A1").Interior.Color
;; Application.Name
;; TypeName(Application.WorksheetFunction)
Application.ScreenUpdating = False ;; Application.ScreenUpdating
;; ActiveWorkbook.Names.Count
ActiveWorkbook.Names.Add "Probe", Range("A1:B2") ;; Left(ActiveWorkbook.Names("Probe").RefersTo, 1) & Right(ActiveWorkbook.Names("Probe").RefersTo, 11)
ActiveWorkbook.Names.Add "Probe", Range("A1:B2") ;; Range("Probe").Address
ActiveWorkbook.Names.Add "Probe", Range("A1:B2"): Range("Probe").Value = 3 ;; Range("B2").Value

# --- worksheet functions ---
Range("A1:A3").Value = 2 ;; Application.WorksheetFunction.Sum(Range("A1:A3"))
Range("A1:A3").Value = 2 ;; Application.WorksheetFunction.Average(Range("A1:A3"))
Range("A1").Value = 1: Range("A2").Value = 5 ;; Application.WorksheetFunction.Max(Range("A1:A2"))
Range("A1").Value = 1: Range("A2").Value = "x" ;; Application.WorksheetFunction.Count(Range("A1:A2"))
Range("A1").Value = 1: Range("A2").Value = "x" ;; Application.WorksheetFunction.CountA(Range("A1:A2"))

# --- shapes ---
;; ActiveSheet.Shapes.Count
;; TypeName(ActiveSheet.Shapes)
;; ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 20, 100, 50).Name
;; ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddShape(5, 10, 20, 100, 50).Name
;; ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddShape(9, 10, 20, 100, 50).Name
;; ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddTextbox(1, 10, 20, 100, 50).Name
;; ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddLine(10, 20, 100, 50).Name
;; ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(0, 10, 20, 100, 50).Name
ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddShape 1, 10, 20, 100, 50 ;; ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddShape(1, 0, 0, 10, 10).Name
ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddShape 1, 10, 20, 100, 50 ;; ActiveSheet.Shapes.Count
ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddShape 1, 10, 20, 100, 50 ;; TypeName(ActiveSheet.Shapes(1))

ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddShape 1, 10, 20, 100, 50 ;; ActiveSheet.Shapes(1).Height
ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddShape 1, 10, 20, 100, 50 ;; ActiveSheet.Shapes(1).OnAction
ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddShape 1, 10, 20, 100, 50 ;; ActiveSheet.Shapes(1).TopLeftCell.Address
ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddShape 1, 10, 20, 100, 50 ;; ActiveSheet.Shapes(1).BottomRightCell.Address
ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddShape 1, 10, 20, 100, 50 ;; ActiveSheet.Shapes(1).ZOrderPosition
ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 20, 100, 50).Name = "Box" ;; ActiveSheet.Shapes("Box").Left
ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 20, 100, 50).OnAction = "Go" ;; ActiveSheet.Shapes(1).OnAction
ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 20, 100, 50).TextFrame.Characters.Text = "Hi" ;; ActiveSheet.Shapes(1).TextFrame.Characters.Text
ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 20, 100, 50).Left = 40 ;; ActiveSheet.Shapes(1).Left
ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddShape 1, 10, 20, 100, 50: ActiveSheet.Shapes(1).Delete ;; ActiveSheet.Shapes.Count
ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddShape 1, 10, 20, 100, 50 ;; ActiveSheet.Shapes("NoSuchShape").Name
ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddShape 1, 10, 20, 100, 50 ;; ActiveSheet.Shapes(2).Name

ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddTextbox 1, 10, 20, 100, 50 ;; ActiveSheet.Shapes(1).AutoShapeType
;; ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10.4, 20.6, 100, 50).Left
ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddShape 1, 10, 20, 100, 50 ;; ActiveSheet.Shapes(1).Name

# --- a value assigned to a member that answers an object goes to its default member ---
Range("A1") = 5 ;; Range("A1").Value
Cells(2, 2) = 7 ;; Range("B2").Value
ActiveSheet.Range("C3") = 8 ;; Range("C3").Value
ActiveSheet.Cells(4, 3) = "x" ;; Range("C4").Value
Range("E1:E2") = 4 ;; Range("E2").Value
Range("A1:B2").Cells(2, 2) = 6 ;; Range("B2").Value

# --- Evaluate: an array constant ---

# --- a formula cut to another sheet ---
ActiveSheet.Name = "CutAway1": Range("E2").Formula = "=D1+B2": Worksheets.Add: Worksheets("CutAway1").Range("E2").Cut ActiveSheet.Range("A1") ;; ActiveSheet.Range("A1").Formula
ActiveSheet.Name = "CutAway2": Range("B2").Value = 1: Range("C2").Formula = "=B2*2": Worksheets.Add: Worksheets("CutAway2").Range("B2:C2").Cut ActiveSheet.Range("A1") ;; ActiveSheet.Range("B1").Formula

Worksheets("NoSuchSheet").Name

# --- the number format a formula takes from what it refers to ---
# A1 holds a date, A2 a plain number; C1 gets the formula. Each answer is
# C1's NumberFormat and the type its Value arrives as.
Range("A1").Value = DateSerial(2020, 1, 15): Range("A2").Value = 5: Range("C1").Formula = "=A1" ;; Range("C1").NumberFormat & "|" & TypeName(Range("C1").Value)

Range("A1:A3").Value = Application.Transpose(Array(1, 2, 3)): Range("C1:C3").FormulaArray = "=A1:A3*10": Range("E1").FormulaArray = "=1" ;; Range("C1:E3").FormulaArray
Range("A1:A3").Value = Application.Transpose(Array(1, 2, 3)): Range("C1:C3").FormulaArray = "=A1:A3*10" ;; Range("C1:C3").CurrentArray.Address

# --- CallByName: a member named at run time ---
Range("A1").Value = 5 ;; CallByName(Range("A1"), "Value", VbGet)
Range("A1").Value = 5 ;; CallByName(Range("A1"), "vALUE", VbGet)
CallByName Range("A1"), "Value", VbLet, 42 ;; Range("A1").Value
;; CallByName(Range("A1"), "Offset", VbGet, 1, 2).Address
;; CallByName(ActiveSheet, "Range", VbGet, "B2").Address
;; CallByName(ActiveSheet, "Range", VbMethod, "B2:C3").Address
;; CallByName(Range("A1"), "Nope", VbGet)
;; CallByName(Range("A1"), "Value", 3)
;; CallByName(Range("A1"), "Value", 16)
;; CallByName(Nothing, "Value", VbGet)
;; CallByName(5, "Value", VbGet)
;; CallByName("text", "Len", VbGet)
CallByName Range("A1").Font, "Bold", VbLet, True ;; Range("A1").Font.Bold
Range("A1").Value = 5: CallByName Range("A1"), "ClearContents", VbMethod ;; IsEmpty(Range("A1").Value)
;; TypeName(CallByName(Range("A1"), "ClearContents", VbMethod))
Dim c As New Collection: CallByName c, "Add", VbMethod, "x": CallByName c, "Add", VbMethod, "y" ;; c.Count & "|" & CallByName(c, "Item", VbMethod, 2)
;; CallByName(Range("A1:B2"), "Count", VbGet)
;; TypeName(CallByName(Range("A1"), "Font", VbGet))

;; CallByName(Range("A1"), "Address", VbGet, False, False)
